top5_methods.name: GMADL Custom Loss for LightGBM/CatBoost
top5_methods.key_insight: Direction-aware loss penalizes wrong-direction predictions on large moves more heavily. Naturally ignores label=1 (flat) samples. CatBoost native custom_obj support.

top5_methods.name: Triple GBDT Ensemble (LGB + CatBoost + DART) with Trimmed Mean
top5_methods.key_insight: Take middle 60% of 15 model outputs (5 seeds × 3 algo), then DE thresh optimize. Trimmed mean > simple mean in OOD competitions (Jane Street 1st).

top5_methods.name: VWAP-to-Mid Deviation + Roll Effective Spread (new features)
top5_methods.key_insight: These two features consistently dominate SHAP across all LOB papers but are NOT in our 226-d. VWAP deviation = asymmetric pressure; Roll spread = effective vs quoted spread ratio.

top5_methods.name: Global LOB Normalization (LOBench recommendation)
top5_methods.key_insight: Per-feature z-score (T7/T44) breaks LOB monotonicity constraints. Global z-score (all price cols share mu/sigma, all vol cols share mu/sigma) preserves bid1 > bid2 > ... constraint. LOBench showed this on same 3s/tick China A-share data. May fix fold2 OOD root cause.

top5_methods.name: Covariate-Dependent Stacking (CDST)
top5_methods.key_insight: Instead of fixed ensemble weights, let alpha_k = f(realized_vol, spread_ratio, time_of_day). Stateless-compatible (gate input from 100-tick window). Particularly useful if LGB and CatBoost have complementary strengths across vol regimes.

anti_patterns.name: Per-Feature Adaptive Normalization does not fix cross-sym OOD
anti_patterns.evidence: T44 LOSO seed42 sum = -4.20, fold2 = -8.67 (vs iter_006 fold2 = +1.48)
anti_patterns.root_cause: Per-feature z-score equalizes each column's mean/variance but does NOT align the LOB structural constraints across syms. Tree split thresholds remain sym-specific.
anti_patterns.correct_path: Global normalization (all price cols share mu/sigma). T55 proposed.

anti_patterns.name: Multi-horizon equal-weight stacking degrades precision
anti_patterns.root_cause: h30/h120/h240 models introduce noise. Linear stacker underfits. DE thresh is 4D regardless of how many inputs.
anti_patterns.correct_path: Single-horizon (h60) model is cleaner. If multi-horizon used, each horizon needs its own threshold optimization, not just one shared DE.

anti_patterns.name: Group DRO over-corrects worst-group in small-group settings
anti_patterns.evidence: T45 LOSO DE thresh = 8.66 < iter_006 = 13.61 (fold2 improved -8.89->-2.80 but others dropped)
anti_patterns.root_cause: Only 5 groups (syms), DRO variance too high. Up-weighting sym2 makes model learn sym2-specific features, hurting sym-agnostic generalization.
anti_patterns.correct_path: Fix sym2 OOD via global feature normalization, not loss re-weighting.

notes: LOBench (2505.02139) is the key new finding: same 3s/tick China A-share format as our project, showing global z-score normalization preserves LOB constraints. T44's failure is explained by per-feature normalization being fundamentally insufficient. GMADL (2412.18405) is the top missing direction: direction-aware loss that naturally handles class imbalance and return magnitude weighting.
